description: Source code for AppendOnlyMap class, a specialized hash table implementation optimized for append-only use cases within Apache Spark.

classes.name: AppendOnlyMap
classes.description: A simple open hash table optimized for append-only scenarios, supporting key-value insertions, updates, and sorted iteration.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific key.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Updates the value for a key using a provided function, returning the new value.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key-value pairs in the map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the map.

methods.name: destructiveSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the map's entries in sorted order, destroying the map's internal state.

methods.name: atGrowThreshold
methods.description: Checks if the map has reached its threshold for growth.
